text.text: Scorched fuel tanks and gauges can store supported fluids. A Foundry needs a supported tank in a valid structure position to replenish its fuel. Fuel already acquired can continue burning when the tank is empty.
Fuel tanks and gauges hold 4,000 mB; ingot tanks and gauges hold 4,320 mB.
Some fluid containers and Faucet transfers are supported. Other fluid handlers and game or LAN behavior have not been verified.
